title: Story, format version 1
description: A piece of news that develops over time. Our pipeline writes it from the bots' results, keeps its title and summary current, and adds updates to its timeline.

format.description: Says this record is a story, in format version 1.

id.description: The story's ID. Updates, posts and links refer to the story by it.

title.description: The story's headline, in our own words. Rewritten as the story develops, so it always says where things stand.

summary.description: What is happening, in one or two sentences of our own words.

locations.description: Where the story matters, the main one first. The story shows under each of them, and under no other.

categories.description: What the story is about, the main one first. The story shows under each of them.

state.description: live: readers see it. merged: it turned out to be the same news as another story, which readers see instead. withdrawn: taken down, because our AI found it wasn't true or because the law requires it; readers no longer see it.

merged_into.description: The story this one was merged into, which is never itself merged: its updates and sourced items have moved there, and anything else that names this story is read as naming that one. Only when the state is merged.

withdrawn_reason.description: Why the story was withdrawn, in our own words (our AI's reason, or the takedown the law required), shown to anyone who opens an old link. Only when the state is withdrawn.

created_at.description: When our pipeline first wrote the story.

updated_at.description: When anything about the story last changed, including a new update in its timeline.
